items.zh: 但是任何最后期限都比没有要好。
items.en: But any deadline is better than none.

items.zh: 游手好闲者很可能永远无法填满谷仓。
items.en: Idlers were liable never to fill their barns.

items.zh: 新的竞争者热衷于将自己定位为更健康的选择。
items.en: New competitors are eager to position themselves as a healthier alternative.

items.zh: 无论面对什么挑战，我们团队都有决心克服。
items.en: Whatever challenges we face, our team is fully resolved to overcome them.

items.zh: 这位年轻企业家凭借其独特的视野和卓越的领导力所取得的惊人成就，远远超出了包括他家人在内的所有人的预期。
items.en: The young entrepreneur’s remarkable achievements, built on his unique vision and exceptional leadership, has far exceeded the exceptions of everyone, including his family.
